title: den-wiki sources/ frontmatter
description: Frontmatter of a captured source under sources/. Sources are never edited; a re-fetch is a new file that names the old one in supersedes.

type.description: source for material captured from outside, or agent-output for output of our own agents captured from a run (a harness's report from a calibration run, say), which is a record of the run and never external evidence. OKF requires a type on every document; it also groups the generated index.

source_url.description: Where the material was captured from.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the body: every byte after the line that closes the frontmatter.

captured_by_trail.description: Slug of the trail (trails/<slug>.md) whose run captured this source.

media.description: For a capture of an image, clip or other binary file: where the file is. Either a content-root-relative path under sources/ (normally the source's own <doc>.assets/ folder) or a media store reference /media/<sha256>.<ext>. The Markdown body then describes the file: caption, provenance, transcript.

media_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the media file's bytes. Required with media.

supersedes.description: Content-root-relative path of the earlier capture this one replaces.
